I hear that this matters to you, and I’m willing to reconsider. Comfort can be the immediate priority—for example, when someone is distressed, it may be better to listen and stabilize the situation before raising a difficult truth.

But I wouldn’t adopt the view that comfort should always come first if that means misleading someone. That can undermine trust or cause harm later. What feels selfish or harmful to you about prioritizing honesty?
